videos.caption: Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Nutrition (Per Serving, 4 servings) * Calories: 475 * Protein: 58g * Carbs: 30g * Fat: 18g #homecooking #easyrecipe #chicken #sesamechicken #takeout

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

GREEK CHICKEN & RICE BOWLS 🔥😍 This is the kind of healthy dinner you'll actually crave. Macros (4 serves) • 517kcal  • 40g P • 53g C • 15g F   Ingredients • 1 cup basmati rice • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 onion finely diced • 3 cloves garlic minced • 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp each ground paprika & salt • 3 tbsp each chopped parsley and dill  • 1 1/2 cups chicken broth Chicken • 600g skinless chicken thighs • 1 tsp each salt, dried thyme, ground paprika, garlic powder & onion powder • 2 tsp dried oregano • Zest of lemon + 3 tbsp lemon juice • ½ tbsp honey Tzatziki  • 1 cup low fat Greek yoghurt • 1 Lebanese cucumber grated & excess liquid squeezed • 2 cloves garlic finely minced • 2-3 tbsp dill finely chopped • 1 tbsp lemon juice + ½ tsp salt   Greek Salad • 300g cherry tomatoes halved • 1 cucumber thinly sliced • 1/3 cup light feta crumbles  • ½ red onion thinly sliced • 4 tbsp black olives sliced • 3 tbsp parsley chopped + ½ tsp salt • 1 tbsp lemon juice    Method 1. Marinate chicken: In a bowl, combine the chicken thighs with all the seasonings, lemon zest, lemon juice, and honey and a drizzle olive oil. Mix well to coat and set aside to marinate for at least 15–30 mins (or longer).   2. Cook rice: Rinse rice. Heat oil in a medium pot, sauté onion for 4 minutes, then add garlic and seasonings. Cook for 1–2 mins. Add broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 12–15 mins. Rest for 5 mins before fluffing and stirring through parsley and dill.   3. Cook chicken: Preheat air fryer to 195°C for 3–4 mins. Place chicken in the basket in a single layer, ensuring it is not overcrowded. Cook for 14-16 mins, flipping halfway through, until golden and cooked through. Alternatively, cook in a lightly oiled frying pan over medium-high heat for 4–5 mins per side until cooked through and nicely charred. Rest for 5 mins before slicing.   4. Make tzatziki: Combine all ingredients. Mix until smooth, taste & season.   5. Prepare Greek salad: Combine all ingredients. Toss gently.    Assemble: Divide rice between 4 bowls. Top with chicken, salad and a generous dollop of tzatziki.

This has been my favorite meal prep lunch for a long time. So much flavor & so simple to throw together.  INGREDIENTS: •20 oz chicken breast, diced •1/3 cup honey •2 tbsp soy sauce •2 tsp minced garlic •20 oz broccoli (Or veggie of choice)  •1 1/4 cups jasmine rice INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Cook jasmine rice according to package directions.  2. Add broccoli to a sheet pan, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt, then bake at 425°F for 20 minutes.  3. Dice chicken and cook in a skillet over medium heat for 3–5 minutes, then flip.  4. Add garlic, honey, and soy sauce, stir, and increase heat to medium-high.  5. Let simmer 3–5 minutes until sauce becomes frothy and thickens — keep an eye on it as it can burn quickly.  6. Divide rice, broccoli, and chicken into 5 bowls and store in the fridge.  NUTRITION: Per 1 bowl: 277 calories | 27c | 3f | 31p #mealprep #highprotein #hothoney

4 easy ziploc freezer meals 🤗 Tuscan Chicken Artichoke  Ingredients: 2–3 chicken breasts 2 cups fresh spinach ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped 1 cup cherry tomatoes 1 can artichokes 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 1–2 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning Salt + pepper Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Add to crockpot with ½–1 cup chicken broth. Cook on low 6–8 hours or high 3–4 hours. Stir in ½ cup heavy cream at the end. Serve with pasta, rice, or potatoes. ⸻ Chicken Stir Fry  Ingredients: 1–1.5 lb chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 cup broccoli florets 1 cup carrots (shredded or sliced) 1 cup red bell pepper, sliced 1 cup yellow bell pepper, sliced 1 cup snap peas ½ cup red onion, sliced 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp fresh ginger, minced (optional) 1–2 tbsp olive oil ¼ cup soy sauce 2 tbsp honey 1 tsp sesame oil Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Add to skillet or wok. Cook over medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked and veggies are tender. Serve with rice or noodles. ⸻ Garlic Butter Meatballs Ingredients: 1 bag (about 20–24 oz) frozen meatballs 1–2 cups baby carrots 1–2 cups green beans ½ onion, sliced 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2–3 tbsp melted butter 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning Salt + pepper Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Add to crockpot with ½ cup chicken broth. Cook on low 6–8 hours or high 3–4 hours. Serve with rice, mashed potatoes, or bread. ⸻ BBQ Chicken  Ingredients: 2–3 chicken breasts 1–2 cups corn (frozen or canned) 1 red bell pepper, sliced ½ red onion, sliced 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 1–2 tbsp olive oil ½–1 cup BBQ sauce Salt + pepper Add everything to a freezer bag, mix well, and freeze. When ready to cook: Thaw overnight in the fridge. Add to crockpot. Cook on low 6–8 hours or high 3–4 hours. First up — honey soy chicken bowls: Ingredients: - 1.2kg chicken thigh or breast (thigh = juicier) - 4 cloves garlic, crushed - 2 tsp fresh ginger - 8 tbsp soy sauce - 2 tbsp oyster sauce (optional) - 4 tbsp honey - 2 tbsp tomato paste - 1/2 tsp chilli flakes (optional) Method: 1. Add chicken to the slow cooker. 2. Whisk garlic, ginger, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, tomato paste and chilli flakes together, then pour over the chicken. 3. Cook on low for 6 hours, or until chicken shreds easily. 4. Shred the chicken in the sauce and stir to coat. 5. Serve over rice with your favourite veggies for an easy dinner — and pack the leftovers for lunches all week. #slowcookerrecipe #mealpreprecipes #honeysoychicken #slowcookermeals #highproteinrecipes

(gym) girl dinner on rotation🤏🏼🫧🕯️✨  chicken cutlet ceasar salad 🩶 full recipe:  1.  slice up some red onion and your lettuce of choice  2.  if your chicken breasts aren’t  already thin, slice each breast in half horizontally or pound to about ¼ inch thick.  3. Set up your breading station..  Get out two shallow bowls: beaten eggs in the first, Italian breadcrumbs in the second. (I add garlic powder, salt and pepper to the breadcrumbs, about 2 tsp each) 4. Dredge each cutlet in the egg mixture, then press into the breadcrumbs to coat both sides fully. 5. Heat about 2tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add your breaded cutlet and cook for about 4 min each side or until internal temp reads 165°. 6. Move to a paper-towel-lined plate and sprinkle with a little salt.  7. Add Ceasar dressing to your lettuce + onion and plate your salad. Top with the cutlet and enjoy !!!  #highproteinrecipe
